get.description: Issues a signed double-submit CSRF token: the value is set in the readable CSRF cookie and returned in the body. The client must echo it in the X-CSRF-Token header on every state-changing request (login, logout, and future writes).

post.description: Verifies credentials, creates a fresh server-side session and sets the secure session cookie. Failures are generic; throttled attempts return 429. Requires the X-CSRF-Token header from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf.

503.description: Authentication is not configured or the database is unavailable.

post.description: Requires a valid session and the X-CSRF-Token header. Revokes the server-side session (irreversible) and expires the cookies. Replay of the old session fails.

Publicly readable.
